# traduzai

> TraduzAI is an Adobe Illustrator ExtendScript (TraduzAI.jsx) with a ScriptUI panel that runs a user-recorded "Make Text Dynamic" Action in batches over selected text objects, turning them into Illustrator variables, and exports the texts to a UTF-8 CSV. The CSV is translated (Google Sheets, AI or a translator) and loaded back as an Illustrator variable library to switch languages. For designers localizing artwork; requires Illustrator 2023+.

## Files
- [TraduzAI.jsx](https://github.com/WednyFernandes/traduzai/blob/main/TraduzAI.jsx): the script (UI, batch processing, CSV export)
- [LANGUAGE-CONFIG.md](https://github.com/WednyFernandes/traduzai/blob/main/LANGUAGE-CONFIG.md): Action set names per Illustrator language
- [README](https://github.com/WednyFernandes/traduzai/blob/main/README.md): install, usage, translation workflow, FAQ
- [README-ptBR.md](https://github.com/WednyFernandes/traduzai/blob/main/README-ptBR.md): Portuguese documentation

## Key facts
- Install: copy TraduzAI.jsx to Illustrator's Presets/[language]/Scripts folder, run via File > Scripts > TraduzAI
- Settings: ACTION_NAME (default setvar), ACTION_SET (default "Ações Padrão"), VARIABLE_PREFIX (default "Variável"), editable in the panel
- Processes at most 2 objects per batch; warns above 50 selected objects and above 100
- Optional automatic backup saves a -backup.ai copy before processing
- "Exportar CSV Existente" exports variables already in the document
- CSV: header row of variable names, then one row per language; use ^n for line breaks
- It does not translate text and cannot create the Action itself
- TradutorCSVpy/ is a separate legacy Python CSV translator
